notes.title: Viviette is available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you can see, our new game [b][i]Viviette[/i][/b] is available now! We hope you like this hand crafted exploration adventure, and also the horror side of the experience. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoilers before playing. Long long time ago we had this idea floating around our heads, and just this year we decided to make it a reality. And this is the result!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018137/f8c01d882ac3b853c17600acdbd02369af08e220.jpg[/img]

As we have mentioned before, this is a [b]classic horror[/b] game where you'll have to [b]explore[/b] and solve some [b]puzzles[/b]. In adversity, you should persevere. We really encourage solving everything by yourselves. But if you need any help, we're sure other players will assist you in the game's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussion forums[/url].

That's all we have to say, to be honest. Just enjoy the experience!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, [b]Viviette[/b], now has an official release date:

[h1]18 October 2018[/h1]

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an [b]exploration-puzzle[/b] game with touches of [b]classic horror[/b]. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussions forum[/url]. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Update v1.6.6 - Portuguese and Chinese languages!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567532/52083943475ff7574340d828e13a8f6b0948df8a.gif[/img]

Since v.1.6.0, we have been adding new stuff and adjusting this game. The most notorious additions in [b]v1.6.6[/b] are [b]Portuguese[/b] and [b]Chinese[/b] fan made translations. Portuguese localization by [url=steamcommunity.com/id/Ragn4r0k][b]Ruffles[/b][/url] and Chinese localization by [url=steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198088109477][b]MasterJutou[/b][/url]. Big thanks!

Also, we have recently added a new window size mode: [b]Stretch[/b]. Now, on non 16:9 screens, the game will stretch and cover all the screen (just in case you don't like black borders).

So, let's sum up the most important changes present in the current [b]v1.6.6[/b] (available for Windows, Mac and Linux):

- Portuguese language.
- Chinese language.
- New window size option: Stretch.
- New button for changing to Previous Weapon.
- Config your gamepad pressing SPACE on your keyboard.
- Faster cutscene pacing.
- Skip single phrases in cutscenes.
- Fixed bug that may freeze some computers on Exit.
- Performance improvements.
- Minor fixes.

Thanks for your support! If you finish and like this game, don't forget to write a review, because that helps more than you think!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Difficulty Modes overhaul!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567532/fa936e712728d01cb075297cf4a4af3c579e953a.png[/img]

New update!

We have modified how [b]difficulty modes[/b] work in order to help newcomers adapt to this demanding game. Now we have [b]Easy[/b], [b]Normal[/b] and [b]Hard[/b] modes. The default difficulty mode is Normal.

[h1]Hard Mode[/h1]
- Limited time to beat the game.
- No life recovery items.

[h1]Normal Mode[/h1]
- Limited time to beat the game.
- Life recovery items available.
- Slower enemy bullets.
- Player weapons deal more damage.

[h1]Easy Mode[/h1]
- Unlimited time to beat the game.
- Life recovery items available.
- Even slower enemy bullets.
- Player weapons deal even more damage.

The game is still demanding with players, regardless of the selected difficulty mode, but hopefully this new approach will help new players adapt to the game and enjoy the adventure.

Our advice: try beating the first five stages in Normal or Easy mode. If you cannot beat that part of the game on that difficulty setting, then you should probably ask for a refund. Anyway, getting better at the game it's a matter of time, practice and patience.

Thanks for your time!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: New "Extra Missions" game mode!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567532/4b1b02ed43f8dbb15d80997669f9059acab3a41d.png[/img]

Big update!

Since today, a new game mode titled "[b]Extra Missions[/b]" has been added to the game. This new mode is accessible from the title main menu, but only [b]after you beat the game in story mode[/b] (i.e, you have unlocked the "[i]Revenger[/i]" achievement).

This mode adds another [b]25 stages[/b], maybe harder than the normal ones due to more crowded waves of bots and enemy vehicles. Also, the last stage of the Extra Missions mode is a [b]Boss Rush[/b], that we think you'll enjoy.

So, that's it! A reward for those who love the game and want to prove their skills even further.

Enjoy!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567532/70cd338096836dec76ef1c0c1f816c98cd8d7870.png[/img]

Hello!

As you can see, [b]Bot Vice[/b] is [b]15% OFF[/b] right now, a fantastic deal for those that missed the release sale. It will be on sale until September 26th. It's a great opportunity to pick this action packed game and enjoy this new take on classic [b]gallery shooting[/b] gameplay, the hardcore way, hehe! Also, your support will help us finish our next project with even higher quality, if anything!

The current game build (v1.1.5) is stable (well, the game is stable since v1.1). In fact, the game was released almost bug free, and that's amazing for a small two people real indie team like we are. The only important missing features were the "Easy" difficulty mode and the keyboard/gamepad rebinding, which were available since v1.1 (4 days after official launch, ultra fast!). You can see the full changelog here: [url=steamcommunity.com/app/491040/discussions/0/358417461605391771/]Bot Vice Changelog[/url].

Although we're working on our next title fulltime and it has the highest priority now, we're still working on Bot Vice and supporting our players. So, if you find any critical bug, please, let us know in the support forums: [url=steamcommunity.com/app/491040/discussions/1/]Bot Vice Support Forums[/url].

Ah, more things! For those who are interested in how we make our high quality pixel art graphics, we recommend you to check our [b]COOL PIXEL ART![/b] video series on [url=youtube.com/channel/UC3DZ93Nbou0F4P85Xnq4Ogw]our YouTube channel[/url], or simply [url=twitter.com/DYAGames]follow us on Twitter[/url].

And that's all! Thanks [b]a lot[/b] for your support, for your time and for playing!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Bot Vice v1.1 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567532/13a7161ae6dc858d03dc17ab39c441a34a8a5046.png[/img]

Hello!

After listening to players' issues and suggestions, Bot Vice has been updated to [b]v1.1[/b], featuring the following changes:

[u][b]New "Easy" difficulty mode.[/b][/u]
In this new level of difficulty, some yellow bots will drop Heart items for recovering one life point. It's a drastic change in this game philosophy that hopefully will help some players. The game will never be easier than that, because we don't want to distort our initial vision for this experience.

[u][b]Customizable keyboard and gamepad controls.[/b][/u]
Now you can customize keyboard and gamepad controls to your liking in order to feel comfortable enough to beat this challenge.

[u][b]New versatile "Window Size" option.[/b][/u]
"Fit screen" option was replaced by "Window size". Now you can set the game screen size to 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x or Full size (fitting your full display size).

[u][b]City map cursor cycle.[/b][/u]
In the City Map, press left while the cursor is on Stage 1 to go back to the latest unlocked stage.

[u][b]Attack with Saber while shooting.[/b][/u]
Very useful when playing with keyboard, now the Saber has priority over Shooting, so you can use the Saber key even if you're already holding down the Shooting key. Remember that the saber can destroy any type of projectile, bombs included!

[u][b]Faster automatic shooting with the Handgun.[/b][/u]
We have increased the Handgun automatic shooting cadence. Now it shoots faster while holding down the shooting key or button.

[u][b]Quick stage restart by pressing "0" on the keyboard.[/b][/u]
You can restart any stage immediately pressing "0" key on your keyboard.

[u][b]New name for the flying red guy: "Cheesy" James.[/b][/u]
Inside joke.

[u][b]Several minor fixes and adjustments.[/b][/u]
It's just that.

Thansk for playing!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]
